page: Microsoft Azure E96ds_v7 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance running on Microsoft Hyper-V. It is powered by the x86_64 Intel Xeon 6973P-C processor operating at 4.2 GHz across 48 physical cores and 96 dedicated vCPUs with hyperthreading enabled. The configuration delivers 768 GB of total system RAM, establishing an 8 GB per vCPU memory ratio. Complementing the compute and memory array is 5,669 GB of integrated local NVMe SSD storage, a 480 MB L3 cache, and zero discrete GPUs. Architectural capabilities include hardware acceleration support for AVX-512, AMX int8 matrix extensions, and cryptographic acceleration instructions such as VAES and SHA-NI.

In benchmark evaluations, the E96ds_v7 demonstrates high throughput across multi-threaded computational and memory-bound tasks. The server achieved a PassMark CPU score of 108,743.76 and a stress-ng multi-core result of 101,535.75, placing within top-tier and strong performance percentiles. Its large 480 MB cache structure enables cached small-block read memory bandwidth of 7,496.51 GB/sec, while large-block uncached read memory bandwidth reached 349.8 GB/sec. Synthetic database benchmarks recorded 33,091.29 operations in PassMark, alongside 159.97 million operations per second in Redis SET evaluations. For vectorized and compression tasks, multi-threaded bzip3 decompression delivered 604.11 GB/sec, and CPU-driven prompt processing for small and medium language models placed in the top decile.

The instance provides balanced resource density for enterprise memory and high-capacity local disk operations without requiring discrete GPU accelerators. While its single-core stress-ng performance falls within the middle fifty percent, its extensive core count and hardware acceleration extensions deliver efficient parallel throughput per allocated resource. The inclusion of 5,669 GB of integrated NVMe storage reduces external block storage overhead for high-frequency scratch and cache applications. Microsoft Azure E96ds_v7 is suited for large-scale in-memory databases like Redis, transactional relational database management systems, big data analytics engines, high-concurrency static web serving, and memory-intensive ETL pipelines.
description: Microsoft Azure E96ds_v7 is a memory-optimized cloud server driven by an Intel Xeon 6973P-C processor with 96 dedicated vCPUs, 48 physical cores, and a 4.2 GHz clock speed on Microsoft Hyper-V. The system is equipped with 768 GB of memory, yielding 8 GB of RAM per vCPU, alongside a 480 MB L3 cache and 5,669 GB of bundled local NVMe SSD storage without discrete GPUs. Incorporating AVX-512 and AMX instructions, it delivers top-tier performance in multi-threaded benchmarks, registering over 108,000 on PassMark CPU evaluations, 159.97 million operations per second on Redis SET benchmarks, and high cached memory throughput. The server provides a high-density compute-to-memory profile that yields strong resource efficiency for data-intensive processing without requiring external storage overhead for cache layers. Azure E96ds_v7 is suited for enterprise relational databases, distributed in-memory data grids, large-scale caching, and memory-demanding data transformation pipelines.
